national_questions.qe: What is the name of the AI‑based tool launched by SEBI to detect financial fraud on social media?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी का पता लगाने के लिए सेबी द्वारा लॉन्च किए गए एआई‑आधारित टूल का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because SEBI announced the AI tool named ‘Sudarshan’ for multi‑stage fraud detection.
• Option A is Incorrect; ‘Suraksha’ is not the name of the tool.
• Option C is Incorrect; ‘Samved’ is unrelated to SEBI’s AI initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect; ‘Sanchalak’ is not the tool launched by SEBI.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following projects was NOT inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Ekta Nagar on Rashtriya Ekta Diwas?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस पर प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा एकता नगर में किस परियोजना का उद्घाटन नहीं किया गया?
oe: Artificial Rain Forest with a circular glass skywalk
oh: वृत्ताकार कांच के स्काईवॉक के साथ कृत्रिम रेन फॉरेस्ट
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because a new metro line was not among the projects listed for inauguration.
• Option A is Incorrect; the 12‑acre artificial Rain Forest with glass skywalk was inaugurated.
• Option B is Incorrect; Vaman Vriksha Vatika was part of the inaugurated projects.
• Option D is Incorrect; Ekta Cruise was also inaugurated at the event.

national_questions.qe: Where is India’s first indigenous high‑speed bullet train set “B28” being manufactured?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी हाई‑स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन सेट “B28” कहाँ निर्मित हो रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the B28 set is being built at BEML’s Bengaluru workshop in collaboration with ICF.
• Option A is Incorrect because ICF is only a partner for design and testing, not the primary manufacturing site.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala manufactures conventional coaches, not the bullet‑train set.
• Option D is Incorrect because Alstom does not have a manufacturing unit for the indigenous B28 project.

national_questions.qe: Which former Central Vigilance Commissioner was appointed chairperson of the High‑Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat?
national_questions.qh: विकसित भारत के लिए बैंकिंग पर हाई‑लेवल कमेटी के चेयरपर्सन के रूप में किस पूर्व केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयुक्त को नियुक्त किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the committee was chaired by former CVC Suresh N. Patel.
• Option B is Incorrect; Raghuram Rajan is a former RBI Governor, not appointed to this committee.
• Option C is Incorrect; Urjit Patel is also a former RBI Governor, not the chair.
• Option D is Incorrect; Shaktikanta Das is the current RBI Governor, not a committee member.

national_questions.qe: What was the amount of the additional advance tax devolution released by the Union Finance Ministry to states on 31 October 2026?
national_questions.qh: 31 अक्टूबर 2026 को केंद्र वित्त मंत्रालय द्वारा राज्यों को जारी किए गए अतिरिक्त अग्रिम कर हस्तांतरण की राशि क्या थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry released an additional ₹1,09,019 crore on the stated date.
• Option A is Incorrect; ₹85,000 crore does not match the announced figure.
• Option C is Incorrect; ₹1,25,500 crore exceeds the actual amount.
• Option D is Incorrect; ₹95,750 crore is not the amount disclosed.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of the insecticide molecule that is India’s first indigenously discovered and commercialised as Pioxazon?
national_questions.qh: भारत में पहली बार स्वदेशी रूप से खोजी गई और पियोक्साज़ोन के रूप में व्यावसायीकरण की गई कीटाणुनाशक अणु का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Pioxaniliprole is the first insecticide molecule discovered in India and launched commercially as Pioxazon for rice, maize and Bengal gram.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chlorpyrifos is an imported insecticide, not an indigenous discovery.
• Option C is Incorrect because Imidacloprid is a synthetic insecticide developed abroad.
• Option D is Incorrect because Cypermethrin is a widely used synthetic insecticide, not the first Indian‑discovered molecule.

national_questions.qe: Under which central scheme was Khaira village in Chhattisgarh declared India’s first 100% solar village?
national_questions.qh: छत्तीसगढ़ के खैरा गांव को भारत का पहला 100% सौर गांव घोषित करने के लिए कौन सी केंद्रीय योजना लागू की गई?
oe: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana
oh: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्राम ज्योति योजना
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Khaira village achieved 100% rooftop solar coverage under the PM Surya Ghar Yojana (Muft Bijli Yojana).
• Option A is Incorrect as Saubhagya focuses on household electrification, not solar rooftop deployment.
• Option C is Incorrect; Ujjwal Bharat is a broader rural electrification program.
• Option D is Incorrect; Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana deals with power supply to villages, not solar installations.

national_questions.qe: Which state government signed an MoU with Ion Beam Applications SA subsidiary to set up India’s first public proton beam therapy centre?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी राज्य सरकार ने आयन बीम एप्लिकेशन्स SA की सहायक कंपनी के साथ भारत के पहले सार्वजनिक प्रोटॉन बीम थेरेपी केंद्र की स्थापना के लिए समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Assam government signed the MoU with Ion Beam Applications SA subsidiary for a Rs 600 crore public proton beam therapy unit in Guwahati.
• Option A is Incorrect; Kerala has not announced such a MoU.
• Option B is Incorrect; Maharashtra’s initiatives are unrelated to this specific public proton therapy project.
• Option D is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu has private proton therapy centres but no public MoU of this nature.

bihar_questions.qe: Which organization is responsible for setting up the Space Gallery and Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium?
bihar_questions.qh: दरभंगा प्लैनेटेरियम में स्पेस गैलरी और इनोवेशन सेंटर स्थापित करने की जिम्मेदारी किस संगठन की है?
oe: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
oh: राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक अनुसंधान एवं प्रशिक्षण परिषद (NCERT)
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ISRO experts inspected the site and the project is being executed under ISRO’s technical support.
• Option B is Incorrect because DST is not involved in this space‑related infrastructure.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Education does not act as the nodal agency for ISRO projects.
• Option D is Incorrect because NCERT focuses on curriculum, not space galleries.
